title: Design Tokens
$comment: The name pattern was ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$, which is stricter than DTCG and stricter than the app: Naming.check accepts any non-blank, non-duplicate name, so a token called `brand color` could be typed, saved, and rejected here. DTCG reserves `$`-prefixed keys and forbids `.`, `{` and `}` in a name — `.` because it separates path segments in a reference, braces because they delimit one.
